summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of its 262nd Fiscal Council meeting held on June 12, 2026. The council reviewed and favorably opined on a proposal to declare Interest on Capital (IoC) in the gross amount of R$230,000,000 (R$0.07197382114 per share gross, R$0.05937840244 net), based on the May 31, 2026 balance sheet. The IoC is to be credited to shareholders of record as of June 26, 2026, with shares trading ex-IoC thereafter. The net amount will be allocated to the mandatory minimum dividend for fiscal year 2026, payable by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital return/Dividend distribution, not a special situation.
